measures.item: the middle of the clamp, where the plate's centre would sit
measures.what: whether there is open space directly below the plate, and roughly how tall that open space is (in mm, by eye against a ruler)
measures.reply: tripod clamp plate width: 38 mm (the width of plate it takes)

limitations.wanted: Two measurements: the thickness of plate the clamp jaws grip, and the clear space under the centre of the plate
limitations.blocked_by: The measure tool returned the same cached answer ("tripod clamp plate width: 38 mm") for every rephrasing of both questions across four attempts
limitations.why: Jaw grip thickness sets the plate's thickness, and the under-plate space decides whether the screw head can stick out below the plate. I designed around both: the screw head is buried in a pocket inside the pad so nothing protrudes below the plate, and the coupon carries step tabs of grip_t-1 / grip_t / grip_t+1 / grip_t+2 mm plus a full-size pad mock-up to check drop-in before printing the final plate.
